mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(repair_required_yn, 'N') FROM qfield.facility_total_view WHERE total_id = #{totalId} AND use_yn = 'y' LIMIT 1

SELECT json_build_object( 'totalId', #{totalId}, 'items', COALESCE(json_agg( ORDER BY w.work_id DESC), '[]'::json) )::text FROM map.facility_office_work w WHERE w.total_id = #{totalId} AND w.use_yn = 'y'

WITH w AS ( INSERT INTO map.facility_office_work ( total_id, work_status, work_content, dept_nm, manager_nm, manager_tel, plan_date, complete_date, cost, vendor_nm, contract_no, before_photo, after_photo, remark ) VALUES ( #{totalId}, #{work.work_status, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{work.work_content, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{work.dept_nm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{work.manager_nm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{work.manager_tel, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{work.plan_date, jdbcType=DATE}, #{work.complete_date, jdbcType=DATE}, #{work.cost, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{work.vendor_nm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{work.contract_no, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{work.before_photo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{work.after_photo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{work.remark, jdbcType=VARCHAR} ) RETURNING * ) SELECT ::text FROM w

WITH w AS ( UPDATE map.facility_office_work SET work_status = #{work.work_status, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, work_content = #{work.work_content, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, dept_nm = #{work.dept_nm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, manager_nm = #{work.manager_nm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, manager_tel = #{work.manager_tel, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, plan_date = #{work.plan_date, jdbcType=DATE}, complete_date = #{work.complete_date, jdbcType=DATE}, cost = #{work.cost, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, vendor_nm = #{work.vendor_nm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, contract_no = #{work.contract_no, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, before_photo = #{work.before_photo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, after_photo = #{work.after_photo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, remark = #{work.remark, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, update_at = now() WHERE work_id = #{workId} AND use_yn = 'y' RETURNING * ) SELECT ::text FROM w
